people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God; for he was afraid because of the sword of Yahweh’s angel.
translations.bsb: but David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
